name: Mustarrd DVR Handoff
description: Hands Dispatcharr DVR recordings on catch-up channels to Mustarrd one hour before airtime, with fail-safe verification before removing the native Dispatcharr recording.
author: matrix2669

fields.label: Mustarrd DVR Handoff
fields.description: Catch-up channels are handed to Mustarrd shortly before airtime. Non-catch-up channels are ignored and continue to record with Dispatcharr. A Dispatcharr recording is removed only after the corresponding Mustarrd schedule is verified.

fields.label: Mustarrd URL
fields.help_text: Base URL reachable from the Dispatcharr container.

fields.label: Mustarrd Username
fields.help_text: Use a dedicated Mustarrd user. A download-only user is sufficient when this plugin owns the schedules it creates.

fields.label: Mustarrd Dispatcharr Account ID
fields.help_text: Mustarrd account that points to Dispatcharr's Xtream output. Dispatcharr channel IDs map directly to Xtream stream IDs.

fields.label: Handoff Before Airtime (minutes)
fields.help_text: The plugin begins trying to hand off a catch-up recording this many minutes before its Dispatcharr start time.

fields.label: Handoff Check Schedule (cron)
fields.help_text: 5-field cron. The default checks once per minute so the handoff occurs close to T-60.

fields.label: Dry Run
fields.help_text: When enabled, evaluate and report what would be handed off without creating Mustarrd schedules or deleting Dispatcharr recordings.

actions.label: Test Mustarrd
actions.description: Authenticate and verify the configured Mustarrd account and its catch-up channel list.

actions.label: Run Handoff Check Now
actions.description: Run the same handoff pass used by the cron task.

actions.label: Apply / Update Cron Schedule
actions.description: Register or update the periodic handoff task in Celery Beat.

actions.label: Show Cron Status
actions.description: Show the registered cron expression and recent run state.

actions.label: Remove Cron Schedule
actions.description: Stop automatic handoff checks. Existing Mustarrd and Dispatcharr schedules are not changed.

confirm.title: Remove automatic handoff schedule?
confirm.message: Automatic Mustarrd handoffs will stop until the cron schedule is applied again.
